text:
zoe: Huge thanks to @ishaan and @clare for the whiteboard sprint that saved the product walkthrough at lunch. You two turned chaos into a five-slide miracle. :sparkles:
ishaan: team effort! Clare nailed the sequence diagrams, I hacked together the demo fallback. felt like improv theater. :microphone:
clare: also shoutout to @evan for grabbing the dry-erase markers and @ben for duct-taping the broken easel (truly underappreciated craft). :paintbrush::hammer:
evan: happy to help. markers were ancient, so i left a fresh set in the supply basket with a sticky note.
ben: duct tape saves lives and presentations. claiming the unofficial title "easel whisperer". :crown:
zoe: will add formal kudos to the weekly thread and nominate you all for "conference-room heroes." also ordering a case of kombucha as a thanks. who likes mango?
ishaan: mango forever. kombucha is the new coffee. :mango:
clare: +1 mango. can we also put a tiny plaque on the whiteboard: "saved by improv and duct tape"?
evan: yes pls. made a quick mock: <plaque_mock.png>. dropping in #design.
ben: tiny practical note: easel legs wobble when leg B is loose. i left a fix-it note with spare screws in the AV drawer.
kudos-bot: Awarded 3 kudos to ishaan, 2 kudos to clare, 1 kudos to ben for "Lunch walk-through rescue". Logged in weekly and leaderboard updated.
zoe: thanks everyone. small acts = huge confidence boost. i'll put the kombucha in the fridge at 3pm. dietary note: one mango-free option for those who prefer plain.
clare: grateful! spreading the love and documenting the fallback steps in the runbook so next time it's less improv.
ishaan: we can also add a pre-demo checklist to #eng to avoid last-minute whiteboard panic.
evan: moral of the story: markers, screws, and friends.
ben: signing off with duct-tape salute. :adhesive_bandage:
kudos-bot: Reminder: add your kudos to the weekly recap if you want them highlighted on the all-hands
